newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore gas oil done at 5-yr high of $33/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Singapore gas oil done at 5-yr high of $33/bbl.

text.p: Singapore physical gas oil was sold late on Thursday at a new post Gulf War high of $33.00 per barrel on a free-on-board (fob) basis, up $1.20 from the previous high of $31.80 done last week, traders said.
The 220,000-barrel cargo was sold by a European major to a Singapore trader for December 30-January 3 lifting, the seller confirmed.
The rocketing gas oil prices was due to Chinese demand and tight prompt supplies. The rally on London's International Petroleum Exchange on Thursday also boosted Asian prices.
Traders also attributed the supply shortfall to the lack of arbitrage shipments from the west for most part of this year, unlike in previous years.
